# Contractor Brief Index

Markdown milestone files are the internal scope authority. Word/PDF briefs are generated external deliverables with commercial and signature terms.

| Brief | Internal source | Current external status |
|---|---|---|
| Milestone 1 Art Outsourcing Brief | `docs/art_production/milestones/MILESTONE_01.md` | Existing Word/PDF brief; verify against Markdown before signing |
| Milestone 2 Art Outsourcing Brief | `docs/art_production/milestones/MILESTONE_02.md` | Updated Word draft exists; regenerate after final Markdown review |
| Milestones 3–7 | Corresponding milestone Markdown files | Not yet exported |

## Export rule

Before generating or sending a contractor document:

1. Confirm the Markdown milestone status and scope.
2. Review authoritative gameplay/content dependencies.
3. Generate the Word document.
4. Compare included/deferred scope against Markdown.
5. Record the export in `EXPORT_HISTORY.md`.
6. Treat later Word edits as changes that must be reconciled back into Markdown.
